<div id="spn-pilgrimage">
  <h2>A pilgrimage through the museum</h2>
  <div class="viz-controls">
    <button class="btn" type="button" data-prev>Previous</button>
    <label class="form-label">Museum stop<select class="form-select" data-stop></select></label>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" data-next>Next</button>
  </div>
  <div class="text-small">Full route in soft color · selected stop in bold</div>
  <div class="viz-row text-small" data-regions aria-label="Region colors"></div>
  <div class="journey-maps">
    <section><h3>Museum</h3><div data-museum></div></section>
    <section><h3>India</h3><div data-india></div><div data-places class="text-small"></div><div data-map-choices></div></section>
  </div>
  <div class="card" id="spn-journey-current" aria-live="polite" data-detail></div>
  <details><summary>About this route</summary><p>Start in Kerala at 52, follow the southern aisle to 57, then return through Karnataka and Andhra to 51, the Puducherry–Pune bridge into the West. India’s lines connect the display places rather than reconstructing one saint’s journeys.</p><p>Final proposal for tonight · city groups reviewed. Physical fit remains to be confirmed. City groupings retain provisional inventory clues where biographical evidence is incomplete.</p><p>Geography: Natural Earth, 1:110m country boundaries; GeoNames populated-place coordinates. Town markers are approximate. <span data-source-links></span></p></details>
</div>
